verdict.rationale: Zero's MCP server exposes many core email actions (search, send, draft, delete, labels, AI compose, thread Q&A) that mirror UI functionality, giving strong API-parity for mail operations. However missing for 10: no evidence of API parity for UI-specific settings like customizable keyboard shortcuts, UI theming/customization, unified inbox provider management, or account/connection setup via API — these remain UI-only per docs, and there's no independent confirmation the MCP surface is fully comprehensive versus a curated subset.
